functions.name: search_autocomplete
functions.description:
Search for knowledge graph items in a context-sensitive way by specifying a constraining SPARQL query together with a search query. The SPARQL query must be a SELECT query with a variable ?search occurring at least once in the WHERE clause. The search is then restricted to knowledge graph items that fit at the ?search positions in the SPARQL query. This function uses the index type for entities of the given knowledge graph internally if the ?search variable first occurs at the subject or object position, and the index type for properties otherwise.

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
SELECT ?earlier ?earlierLabel ?yearEarlier ?later ?laterLabel ?yearLater WHERE {
  BIND(dbr:Donald_Leroy_Truesdell AS ?p1)
  BIND(dbr:Leny_Marenbach AS ?p2)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?p1 dbo:birthDate ?bd1 .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?p2 dbo:birthDate ?bd2 .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?p1 dc:subject ?cat1 .
    FILTER(regex(str(?cat1) , "Category:\\d{4}_births"))
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?p2 dc:subject ?cat2 .
    FILTER(regex(str(?cat2) , "Category:\\d{4}_births"))
  }
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?bd1) , YEAR(?bd1) , xsd:integer(REPLACE(str(?cat1) , "^.*Category:(\\d{4})_births.*$" , "$1"))) AS ?y1)
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?bd2) , YEAR(?bd2) , xsd:integer(REPLACE(str(?cat2) , "^.*Category:(\\d{4})_births.*$" , "$1"))) AS ?y2)
  FILTER(BOUND(?y1) && BOUND(?y2))
  BIND(IF(?y1 < ?y2 , ?p1 , ?p2) AS ?earlier)
  BIND(IF(?y1 < ?y2 , ?y1 , ?y2) AS ?yearEarlier)
  BIND(IF(?y1 < ?y2 , ?p2 , ?p1) AS ?later)
  BIND(IF(?y1 < ?y2 , ?y2 , ?y1) AS ?yearLater)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?earlier rdfs:label ?earlierLabel .
    FILTER(lang(?earlierLabel) = "en")
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?later rdfs:label ?laterLabel .
    FILTER(lang(?laterLabel) = "en")
  }
}
